Well met, friend. My name is Girulian; as you might suspect by now, I am also a Guardian working with the SMASH unit.
That was an intense and invigorating battle; no doubt the end must be near.
I hear the sounds of machinery up ahead; the penguins' leader draws close.
I would go with you, but I have to stay to call for backup in case worst comes to worst.
Go now! The fate of Techno City lies in your hands!
My apologies for dropping in unannounced. You looked like you needed help.
My name is Jinrei; I am a Guardian who fights with SMASH to protect this fine city.
I take it you have met Zeldia? Nevertheless, there is little time to lose. More enemies await us.
The penguin threat must be eliminated at all costs; I am sure you will find more of my allies ahead to aid you.
I will stay to secure this area and ensure the penguins do not re-infest it. Please, move on without me.
Hmm. You responded to our distress signal? You certainly don't look like you're from around these parts. My name's Zeldia.
A Protector, you say? Well, that's close enough to being a Guardian...you might not be with SMASH, but we need all the help we can get.
The penguins are swarming all over the highway, causing all sorts of chaos. We're heavily outnumbered here, you'll be facing awful odds.
Some of my friends are out there, so they might even things out a bit. If you see them, tell them I said hi.
The penguins won't show you any mercy, so show them none! We've got to restore order to this city!
A new face...
